verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust framework whose core crates (e.g. proa_core, proa_framework_core) are an official programmatic surface. It also claims you can call Proa over FFI from Node, Go, Python, Ruby, or Java, which suggests multi-language bindings. These are only one-line marketing claims, with no named packages, API references, or install instructions for those languages. Missing for 10: named official SDK packages per language, SDK reference docs and install steps, versioning/maintenance details, independent or hands-on corroboration of the FFI bindings.
